title: Understanding Your Statement — Itemized Statements and Statement Delivery, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Itemized statement.** A patient may ask at any time for an itemized statement of the Patient Financial Account, listing every charge, payment and adjustment by date of service and encounter. It is requested on a billing case of the itemized-statement type and delivered within the class's itemized-statement delivery period, in business days, at the class's itemized-statement fee (0.00 on every class).

**What an itemized statement does not do.** The itemized statement is informational: it does not advance the statement's number in the unpaid series, does not restart the unpaid series, and does not by itself open a dispute.

**How statements reach you.** Statements go by the account's statement delivery channel. A patient whose portal is not active receives mail regardless of the recorded preference. A newly opened account starts with its class's default statement channel, and the patient may change it at any time.

| Recorded channel | Portal active | Statement delivered by |
|---|---|---|
| paperless | yes | paperless delivery |
| paperless | no | mail |
| mail | yes or no | mail |

**Q. Does asking for an itemized statement reset the count of unpaid statements?** No. It neither advances the number nor restarts the series.
